notes: Harness Gap #2 (sibling to Gap #1 workflow-secret-lint, #630). Closes the IFC-033 vector: CodeQL default-setup ignores codeql-config.yml and flags vendored inline JS as noise. Adds an expanded codeql-config.yml paths-ignore (default query suites security-extended + security-and-quality PRESERVED) + a durable REQUIRED pre-ship gate (vendored-js-lint.mjs) that blocks oversized inline <script> in tracked HTML regardless of which CodeQL setup GitHub runs. Runs clean on the live 64-file tracked-HTML corpus. The pipeline security-review found + fixed a real false-negative in THIS exec: the external-script skip /\bsrc\s*=/i also matched inside data-src=, so an oversized inline body on <script data-src> was misread as external and skipped; tightened to /(^|\s)src\s*=/i with a regression test; also added uppercase-<SCRIPT> + CLI --threshold=/--json tests (26->30). Deferred follow-ups (documented, security-review decision): the sum-of-blocks bypass (max-single-block comparison; sum-based risks mockup false positives) and the CI-mirror gap (pre-ship-only, shared with Gap #1). ENG-OPS-003 Gap tasks are attestation-tracked (not Sprint_plan.csv rows), like #637/#638 — no CSV flip. No pre-ship bypass, no --no-verify, no destructive git.
